```sql
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
pos_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.currency = 'AUD' THEN t.line_total * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1)
                ELSE t.line_total
            END
        ) AS rev
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON t.txn_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE t.txn_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
      AND t.is_valid = true
),
ecom_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.line_total * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1)
                ELSE l.line_total
            END
        ) AS rev
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON o.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
      AND o.order_status != 'CANCELLED'
),
erp_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.net_value * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1)
                ELSE l.net_value
            END
        ) AS rev
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON l.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE l.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
)
SELECT (COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM pos_rev), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM ecom_rev), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM erp_rev), 0)) AS answer
```
